answer.text:
Adobe’s Digital Media segment revenue in fiscal 2024 was **$15,864 million ($15.864 billion)**, up **12%** year over year from **$14,216 million** in fiscal 2023.

Calculation: \((15{,}864 - 14{,}216) \div 14{,}216 \times 100 \approx 11.6\%\), which rounds to **12%**.

Source: Adobe Inc. 10-K, accession **0000796343-25-000004**, **Segments**, chunk **839ad4e2-d434-562b-b699-c27185c0972b**.
